Definition: to hide by covering; specifically, to roof (passive participle as noun, a roof) or wainscot; figuratively, to reserve
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cover, cover in, wainscotted, covered with boards or panelling; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cover in, panel; 1a2) covered, panelled (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
